items.titulo: OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80%
items.resumen: OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend for its monorepo. It handles branches independently, reuses stored packfiles across fetches, cut median push latency by nearly 80%, and now delivers nearly a petabyte of Git data per day. items.titulo: I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location (and it's everywhere) - YouTube
items.resumen: I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location (and it's everywhere) - YouTube Genius piece of OSINT by Colsto, who demonstrates how you can take almost imperceptible background noise of planes from a video soundtrack, figure out their Doppler curves, then cross reference them against ADS-B data to find the exact location of the video based on their speed, distance, and gaps between different flights. Via Lobste.rs Tags: privacy , youtube
